fieldMarks: Gray with cinnamon on the underside and reddish-brown on the back
Bushy, flattened tail reddish beneath, with red, black and white banding on distal hairs
behavior: Feeds mainly on grass, meadow leaves and seeds
Hibernates late September to May or June; active longer in spring and summer than other ground squirrels of drier, lower habitat
habitat: Alpine and subalpine meadows and pastures; open areas, sagebrush flats, mixed brush and grass, croplands; not forests or rocky slopes.
range: Western US: eastern Oregon to southeastern Idaho, northeastern California, northern Nevada and northwestern Utah (NatureServe adds southwestern Idaho, extreme southeastern Utah).
